method: Read these public repository documents before the browser run. Compare each claim to a rendered goal; do not use a documented route as a browser-navigation input.

claims.claim: Studio starts with Design Game and Projects, and Design Game begins a guided Blueprint workflow.
A blank Blueprint is validated before it can become an opened project; invalid input preserves the editor for correction.
renderedGoals: Blank Blueprint rejected before project creation

claims.claim: Projects lists managed and registered projects and offers Import Project with preview before registration.
renderedGoals: Projects registry after creating a project

claims.claim: An opened project exposes Overview, Game Model, Play, Simulation, Replay, and Build/Export.
Certification and Fairness are offered only when the opened project's resolved capabilities support them.
Tabs are keyboard-focusable and narrow layouts collapse navigation while wide content stays contained.
renderedGoals: First-time creator arrives at Studio on a narrow viewport

claims.claim: Cancelled or failed simulations do not surface a partial report as a successful one.
